## Summary
This is to fund work done since [previous invoice](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/discussion/4854-decentration-completed-and-ongoing-work), as well as pre-fund the next 3 months of work for Ramsey (Decentration).
## Roles, responsibilities and duties
Ramsey(Decentration) has the responsibility to deliver Kabocha into a production ready state on behalf of the Edgeware (and newly forming Kabocha) community, in a timely fashion.
### Roles include:
- **key founding startup and setup duties:** (team building, strategy, RnD, communications with other stakeholders, including other key stewards, Rich (Decent Partners), active contributors, Nathan(Rusty Crew) and Timothee(Rusty Crew, other active contributors, as well as other community members, and the wider passive community, with the purpose of developing Kabocha parachain into an independent organism that co-exists with Edgeware and the Kusama ecosystem.
- product, design development and [product management](https://www.aha.io/roadmapping/guide/product-management/what-is-the-role-of-a-product-manager),
- engineering and maintenance.
